armorPatching:
Receiving damage interrupts HP restoration.

The HP restoration rate and maximum recovery limit are based on the vehicle’s total HP, including all modifiers applied.
brotherhood: The crew efficiency bonus improves the crew member's effectiveness in battle, as well as the effectiveness of all their learned perks, except for this one. This parameter can be further increased by mounting equipment or consumables with a similar effect, or by using the Vent Purge directive. The Commander's Emergency perk, as well as the Radio Operator's Side By Side and Communications Expert perks, can also increase the parameter.
camouflage:
This perk affects vehicle concealment. It can be further improved with the Natural Cover directive.

In addition, vehicle concealment can be increased by applying a camouflage pattern or a style, as well as by mounting equipment with a similar effect.
commander_coordination:
The effect activates each time an enemy vehicle is spotted and does not stack when multiple vehicles are spotted.

Aiming speed can be further increased by training the Gunner's Quick Aiming perk or by mounting equipment with a similar effect.
commander_eagleEye: The view range can be further increased by training the Radio Operator's Situational Awareness perk or by mounting equipment with a similar effect. Using the Optical Calibration directive improves the effect.
commander_emergency: When receiving damage from an enemy repeatedly, the effect does not stack. The crew efficiency bonus improves the crew member's effectiveness in combat. This parameter can be further increased by mounting equipment or consumables with a similar effect, or by using the Vent Purge directive. The group perk Brothers in Arms, as well as the Radio Operator's Side By Side and Communications Expert perks, can also increase the parameter.
commander_enemyShotPredictor:
An alert about enemy SPG fire is activated the moment it is shot but with some delay.

The perk can be improved with the Heightened Vigilance directive.
commander_holdLine:
The crew efficiency bonus improves the crew member's effectiveness in battle.

This parameter can be further increased by mounting equipment or consumables with a similar effect, or by using the Vent Purge directive. Various other crew perks can also increase the parameter.
commander_practical:
The perk works for all types of consumables mounted on your vehicle.

Its effect can be further increased using the Thorough Preparations directive.
commander_sixthSense: Sixth Sense is disabled while the Commander is injured. Its activation time can be reduced with the Radio Operator's Signal Interception perk.
commander_staySharp:
The crew efficiency bonus improves the crew member's effectiveness in battle.

This parameter can be further increased by mounting equipment or consumables with a similar effect, or by using the Vent Purge directive. Various other crew perks can also increase the parameter.
commander_tutor:
An injured Commander cannot replace another crew member. The bonus is applied only to the basic amount of Crew XP earned in battle.

Additional Crew XP can be received by using Crew Books or converting Free XP to Crew XP.
commander_universalist: The Commander can replace only the major qualification of the knocked-out crew member. The replacement effect diminishes with each crew member knocked out.
driver_badRoadsKing:
Reduces penalties to vehicle maneuverability and acceleration when driving on moderately soft terrain. Significantly decreases these penalties when driving on soft terrain, bringing them in line with those of moderately soft terrain.
Maneuverability on moderately soft and soft terrain cannot exceed maneuverability on hard terrain.
driver_bulletproof:
The crew efficiency bonus improves the crew member's effectiveness in battle.

This parameter can be further increased by mounting equipment or consumables with a similar effect, or by using the Vent Purge directive. Various other crew perks can also increase the parameter.
driver_motorExpert: The top speed of your vehicle can be further increased and the penalty to a damaged engine can be further reduced by mounting equipment with a similar effect.
driver_rammingMaster:
The perk is ineffective when two allied vehicles collide.

Ramming damage to your vehicle can be further decreased by mounting equipment with a similar effect.
driver_reliablePlacement: The damage received from HE shells can be further decreased by mounting equipment with a similar effect.
driver_smoothDriving:
Does not affect the accuracy of a stationary vehicle and the accuracy during hull traverse.

The perk can be improved using the Gearbox Intricacy directive. Accuracy when firing on the move can be further increased by mounting equipment with a similar effect or using the Stabilizer Greasing directive.
driver_suspensionRepair: This perk affects the speed of suspension repairs from the red to the yellow state within 50 m of an allied vehicle.
driver_tidyPerson: The fire resistance of the vehicle can be further increased by mounting equipment and consumables with similar effects. The Firefighting perk will speed up putting out a fire if there is one.
driver_virtuoso: Hull traverse speed can be further increased by mounting equipment or consumables with a similar effect.
fireFighting:
This perk affects the damage received from fire and its duration.

If two Radio Operators have this perk, the average value of its training level is applied.

The perk can be improved with the Experienced Firefighters directive.
gunner_armorer:
By default, the potential damage and penetration range is ±25% from the base values. For example, if a shell penetrates armor up to 100 mm and causes 100 HP of damage, upon hitting a target, the actual penetration for this single shot may range from 75 to 125 mm, and the actual damage may range from 75 to 125 HP. Decreasing this modifier will give more predictable shooting results.

If two Gunners have this perk, the average value of its training level is applied.
gunner_focus:
The effect starts 3 s after the vehicle stops and resets upon movement.

If two Gunners have this perk, the average value of its training level is applied.
gunner_loneWolf:
Gun dispersion and aiming speed can be further improved by training crew perks or mounting equipment with a similar effect.

If two Gunners have this perk, the average value of its training level is applied.
gunner_pointBlast:
By default, the potential maximum penetration is +25% from the base value. For example, if a shell penetrates armor up to 100 mm, upon hitting a target, the maximum possible penetration value for this single shot can be 125 mm. Increasing this modifier leads to more effective penetrating results.

If two Gunners have this perk, the average value of its training level is applied.
gunner_quickAiming:
If two Gunners have this perk, the average value of its training level is applied.

Aiming speed can be further increased by training the Commander's Coordination perk or by mounting equipment with a similar effect.

The turret traverse speed can be further increased by mounting equipment or consumables with a similar effect.
gunner_rancorous:
Identifies critically damaged modules on targeted vehicles within the Gunner's view range in both indirect and direct fire modes.
The Gunner's viewing area is defined by the ±10° sector (20° in total) in front of the vehicle's gun and its view range.
If two Gunners have this perk, the average value of its training level is applied.
The perk can be further improved with the Focus on Target directive. Using Improved Radio Set will further increase the time before the enemy vehicle is no longer visible.
gunner_smoothTurret:
If two Gunners have this perk, the average value of its training level is applied.

The perk can be improved with the Steady Hand directive. Dispersion during turret rotation can be further decreased by mounting equipment with a similar effect or using the Stabilizer Greasing directive.
gunner_sniper:
The effect works for all types of shells except in vehicles with autocannons.

If two Gunners have this perk, the average value of its training level is applied.
loader_ammunitionImprove:
By default, the potential minimum damage and penetration range is -25% from the base values. For example, if a shell penetrates armor up to 100 mm and causes 100 HP of damage, upon hitting a target, the minimum possible penetration value for this single shot can be 75 mm, and the minimum possible damage value can be 75 HP. Increasing this modifier leads to more effective shooting results.

If two Loaders have this perk, the average value of its training level is applied.
loader_desperado:
If two Loaders have this perk, the average value of its training level is applied.

Gun loading time can be further decreased by training Loader's Close Combat perk or by mounting equipment with a similar effect. Using the Orderly Ammo Rack directive improves the effect.
loader_intuition:
To activate the perk, the gun, both guns, or the magazine must be fully loaded. The minimum time of changing shell types for standard guns is 1 s; for double-barreled guns and magazine guns, it is 2.5 s.

If two Loaders have this perk, the average value of its training level is applied.
loader_magMastery:
This perk reduces the reload time for magazine guns only and does not affect other gun systems.

If two Loaders have this perk, the average value of its training level is applied.
loader_melee:
If two Loaders have this perk, the average value of its training level is applied.

Gun loading time can be further decreased by training the Loader's Adrenaline Rush perk or by mounting equipment with a similar effect. Using the Orderly Ammo Rack directive improves the effect.
loader_pedant:
An injured Loader does not affect the perk's efficiency.

If two Loaders have this perk, the average value of its training level is applied.

The perk can be improved using the Shell Organizer directive. Ammo rack durability can be further increased by mounting equipment with a similar effect.
loader_perfectCharge:
The effect works for all types of shells.

An injured Loader does not affect the perk's efficiency.

If two Loaders have this perk, the average value of its training level is applied.
loader_secondChance:
This perk has no effect on magazine or autocannon guns and does not stack for dual guns.

For guns with selective loading systems, if both barrels are fired and neither causes damage, the gun loading time reduction applies to both barrels. 

If two Loaders have this perk, the average value of its training level is applied.

Gun loading time can be further decreased by training the Loader's Adrenaline Rush or Close Combat perks or by mounting equipment with a similar effect. Using the Orderly Ammo Rack directive improves the effect.
radioman_battleTempered:
If two Radio Operators have this perk, the average value of its training level is applied.

The effect can be further improved with Commander’s Sound Detection perk.
radioman_expert: The crew efficiency bonus improves the crew member's effectiveness in combat. If two Radio Operators have this perk, the average value of its training level is applied. This parameter can be further increased by mounting equipment or consumables with a similar effect, or by using the Vent Purge directive. The group perk Brothers in Arms, as well as the Commander's Emergency or Radio Operator's Side By Side perks, can also increase the parameter.
radioman_finder:
If two Radio Operators have this perk, the average value of its training level is applied.

The view range can be further increased by training the Recon perk or by mounting equipment with a similar effect. Using the Optical Calibration directive improves the effect.
radioman_interference:
If two Radio Operators have this perk, the average value of its training level is applied.

The time your vehicle remains spotted can be further reduced by mounting equipment with a similar effect.
radioman_lastEffort:
If two Radio Operators have the perk, only the higher value is applied. The effect is only active if the Radio Operator is uninjured when the vehicle is destroyed.

The perk can be further improved with the Duty Comes First directive.
radioman_sideBySide: The crew efficiency bonus improves the crew member's effectiveness in combat. If two Radio Operators have this perk, the average value of its training level is applied. This parameter can be further increased by mounting equipment or consumables with a similar effect, or by using the Vent Purge directive. The group perk Brothers in Arms, as well as the Commander's Emergency or Radio Operator's Communications Expert perks, can also increase the parameter.
radioman_signalInterception:
The effect improves the Commander's special Sixth Sense feature, speeding up its activation.

If two Radio Operators have this perk, the average value of its training level is applied.
radioman_threatSearch:
This perk activates when the Sixth Sense alert indicates your vehicle has been spotted.

If two Radio Operators have this perk, the average value of its training level is applied.

The view range can be further increased by training the Recon or Situational Awareness perks or by mounting equipment with a similar effect. Using the Optical Calibration directive improves the effect.
repair:
This perk affects the speed of internal and external module repairs from the "red" to the "yellow" state.

This parameter can be further increased by mounting equipment or consumables with a similar effect.
